# Design templates

> **Status:** Active  
> **Why does this exist?** Every new addon starts from the same skeleton — not a blank doc.

Copy the relevant template into `RFC/` or lane docs when Architect opens a new product.

---

## Templates

| Template | Use for |
|----------|---------|
| [Machine.md](Machine.md) | Cyber entities (hub, terminal, worker) |
| [Business.md](Business.md) | Player-owned businesses (future) |
| [Weapon.md](Weapon.md) | lpweapons platform |
| [Economy.md](Economy.md) | Currency, pricing, payout rails |
| [UI.md](UI.md) | Razor ops panels, CRT, hub chrome |

---

## Required sections (all templates)

1. **Status** badge (`Draft` until owner approves)
2. **Why does this exist?**
3. **Player fantasy** — who does the player become?
4. **Single authoritative owner** table
5. **Complexity budget**
6. **Design constraints** (never becomes / always remains)
7. **Related decisions** — `DECISION-####` or `RFC-####`
